previous_experiences: Head of R&D and CTO at Skycatch (~8 years), building autonomous drone systems for mining and construction with proprietary 3D reconstruction engine on edge compute.
Led Head of Software Services at Agtonomy, launching TeleFarmer — an all-electric autonomous tractor platform for specialty crop farmers, with partnerships at Treasury Wine Estates and Silver Oak.
Engineer at Twitter working on photos and video on web and iOS.
Built poker-evaluator open-source library (255 GitHub stars) in JavaScript.

Launched Agtonomy TeleFarmer publicly at World Ag Expo in Tulare, CA with a fleet of autonomous tractors.
bio_text: David Chen is GM of Robotics at LiveKit, where he is building foundational real-time infrastructure for the next generation of robotics. He brings nearly a decade of experience as Head of R&D and CTO at Skycatch (autonomous drones for mining/construction) and as Head of Software Services at Agtonomy (autonomous tractors for agriculture), giving him rare end-to-end perspective on shipping autonomous systems in the physical world. His conviction is that production robotics requires purpose-built real-time comms and observability infrastructure — the gap he is now building into LiveKit.
